sources.h1: Weekly overview (2026, week 20): 2 new brands and 20 new pedals
sources.excerpt: Effects Database's May 18, 2026 weekly overview explicitly lists CS.Cathey AD-02 Distortion Box among twenty newly added effects. The same overview separately identifies CS.Cathey AB-03 Distortion Booster and other exact models, establishing AD-02 as a named CS.Cathey pedal record rather than a generic distortion category.
